intro.heading: Container storage in Sturry
intro.leadBefore: Steel 20ft containers on a gated, CCTV-covered yard. Dry, secure and yours to come and go from. Containers from
body: A 20ft container holds about the contents of a three-bed house, or a full van's worth of tools and stock. Plenty of room to walk in and get at what you need.

Drive right up to the door and load straight in — no lifts, no long carry, no booking a slot. Good for builders keeping kit between jobs, traders holding stock overflow, and anyone clearing a house or garage.
Take it for a week or keep it for a year. Pay weekly, no long tie-in. When you're done, hand it back.
